CARD CATALOGUE — the direction

Warm paper, hairline rules, terracotta + moss on ink. Instrument Serif for display, IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for anything the machine measured (scores, counts, chunk ids).

The idea: a library card catalogue crossed with a technical instrument — deliberately not the violet-on-slate AI default.

The retrieval panel on Ask, the chunk markers in the margin of Document, and this graph all show the same thing: what the machine actually matched. Trust in RAG comes from seeing the evidence, not from a spinner.
Copy is written for this product, not filler — but document titles, domains, counts and scores are SAMPLE data. Real facts that I do not have (company, city) are left bracketed.
Every value here is the one used in the screens, and the same tokens are implemented in app/globals.css in the repo.
